notes: The date is provided in both Vikrama Saṃvat (1900) and Nepāla Saṃvat (964). The phrase 'kastena likhitā graṃtha' represents the common scribal formula kaṣṭena likhito granthaḥ ('written with difficulty...'), not a personal name.
